message.content:
Here’s a classic list of ingredients you’ll need to bake a delicious chocolate cake (for about 8‑9 servings). Feel free to adjust quantities or add extras (like espresso powder or sea salt) to suit your taste. | Ingredient | Typical Amount | Notes | |------------|----------------|-------| | **All‑purpose flour** | 1 ¾ cups (220 g) | Sifted for a lighter crumb. | | **Unsweetened cocoa powder** | ¾ cup (75 g) | Use a high‑quality Dutch‑process or natural cocoa for best flavor. | | **Granulated sugar** | 2 cups (400 g) | White or brown; white gives a cleaner taste. | | **Baking powder** | 1 ½ tsp | Helps the cake rise. | | **Baking soda** | 1 ½ tsp | Works with acidic cocoa for lift. | | **Salt** | 1 ½ tsp | Balances sweetness. | | **Eggs** | 2 large | Room temperature for better emulsion. | | **Whole milk** | 1 cup (240 ml) | Room temperature; can substitute with buttermilk for extra tenderness. | | **Vegetable oil** | ½ cup (120 ml) | Neutral‑flavored oil keeps the cake moist. | | **Vanilla extract** | 2 tsp | Adds depth. | | **Boiling water** | 1 cup (240 ml) | Activates cocoa and creates a moist batter. | | **Optional extras** | | • 1–2 tbsp espresso powder (enhances chocolate flavor)
• Pinch of sea salt (brightens sweetness)
• ½ cup chocolate chips or chopped nuts (for texture) | ### Quick Prep Tips 1. **Preheat** your oven to 350 °F (175 °C) and grease two 9‑inch round cake pans (or line with parchment). 2. **Combine dry ingredients** (flour, cocoa, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, salt) in a large bowl. 3. **Mix wet ingredients** (eggs, milk, oil, vanilla) in another bowl. 4. **Blend** wet into dry until just combined, then stir in boiling water (batter will be thin—this is normal). 5. **Bake** 25–30 min, or until a toothpick comes out clean. 6. **Cool** in pans for 10 min, then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely before frosting. Enjoy your homemade chocolate cake!
